author: R3
objection: Separate correction, feasibility and descent inequalities do not establish a jointly admissible corrective step. Require a nonempty common step interval.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: With kappa_j=4 g_j r0_j(1-r0_j) hat_Delta, correction requires eta > M_j/(2 kappa_j m_j), while descent and feasibility require eta < min(2/L, B/(kappa_j ||H x_j||_infinity)); confident wrong or saturated coarse odds can make the interval empty.
author_response: Accepted. Author supplied the maximum lower bound across claimed cells and minimum upper bound across all edited cells, and states that empty interval certifies no jointly corrective step.
modification: DOSSIERS/R3.md, appended Round 1 author response to R2, R2-R1-A.
remaining_disagreement: None. True margins and mixed-cell selection remain latent.

author: R3
objection: The controlled v-path preserves RV:LV odds, but unconstrained native-energy gradient and the actual SGD head probe generally do not. Reachability is not realization or truth-preserving transfer.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: Controlled v=(0,1,-1,1); unconstrained gradient class direction=(0,pi_RV,-1,pi_LV), unequal blood shares alter RV:LV log odds. A nonzero head update alone cannot transfer C2/C3.
author_response: Accepted. Probe explicitly limited to reachability. Added a scalar-v/direct-output control and transfer theorem: infinity error below candidate minimum true signed margin preserves candidate-correct binary labels; observed absolute candidate margin proves only candidate agreement.
modification: DOSSIERS/R3.md, appended Round 1 author response to R2, R2-R1-B.
remaining_disagreement: None. Anatomical candidate margin remains latent and actual network transfer unproved.

author: R3
objection: The generic strict Dice improvement sentence is too strong for false-positive removal when TP=0.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: TP=0 and FN>0 gives Dice=0; removing FP alone leaves Dice=0.
author_response: Accepted. No new errors gives nondecrease; FN correction is strict; FP removal is strict only if TP>0; empty-reference cases need a convention.
